title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 6.88
resolution: Sharp area constant sqrt(27*pi/8), as a consequence of Aharonov-Shapiro-Solynin (1999; 2006). Perimeter existence follows by isoperimetry.
exact_scope: Optimal universal area constant and existence of a positive universal perimeter constant for normalized univalent maps. No optimal perimeter constant or full equality classification claimed.
